abstract.p: This paper presents Arabic hate and hope speech classification using pre-trained language models and advanced data augmentation techniques. We evaluate multiple Arabic BERT variants on 6,889 Arabic text samples labeled as hate speech, hope speech, or not-applicable. Data augmentation through back-translation and LLM-based data generation using few-shot prompting significantly improves performance across all models. We establish strong baselines using ensemble bagging XGBoost alongside traditional machine learning approaches. CAMeLBERT with data augmentation achieves the best Macro-F1 of 0.6868, demonstrating the effectiveness of Arabic-specific models combined with modern augmentation strategies for hate speech detection speech detection.
